_meta.description: Bulk photo editing that matches your style. Develop new photos to look like your previous work or another photographer's style. Create and apply custom LUTs across your entire photo library.
_title: Luma Editor - Match Your Photo Style
absolutely-this-is-a.a8d5fb: Absolutely! This is a great way to learn from photographers you admire. Luma Editor can analyze any photo and apply similar color grading and tone adjustments to your own work, helping you understand different editing styles and develop your own aesthetic.
all-edits-are-completely.90a175: All edits are completely revertible. Change your mind about an edit from last week? No problem. Update, refine, or completely redo any edit at any time.
all-edits-can-be.715ae2: All edits can be reverted and updated anytime later. Experiment freely knowing you can always go back or refine your adjustments.
apply-consistent-edits-across.0fc2e4: Apply consistent edits across multiple photos at once. Save hours of editing time while maintaining professional quality across your entire shoot.
blaine-miller-all-rights.b327c2: © Blaine Miller. All rights reserved.
bulk-photo-editing-that.377ee6: Bulk photo editing that matches your unique style. Develop new photos to look like your previous work or match another photographer's aesthetic. Create custom LUTs and apply consistent edits across your entire photo library with ease.
can-i-edit-photos.d6c2b7: Can I edit photos in bulk?
can-i-match-another.cd195e: Can I match another photographer's style?
create-and-save-custom.ef5900: Create and save custom LUTs that can be exported and used in other photo editing software. Your style becomes portable and reusable across your entire creative workflow.
develop-any-photo-in.e68d4b: Develop any photo in one of your Luma styles straight from Shortcuts or Siri — pick the style and an optional intensity, or leave the style empty and Luma auto-matches the closest one, exactly like in the app. The styled image is returned for chaining into your next action.
develop-new-photos-to.774df0: Develop new photos to automatically match your previously developed photos. Maintain a consistent aesthetic across all your work effortlessly.
develop-photos-that-match.9ee742: Develop photos that match your signature look or any style you love
does-it-work-with.2fe73c: Does it work with my Photos library?
generate-luts-lookup-tables.4b7b42: Generate LUTs (Lookup Tables) from your edits that can be applied in other apps and software. Export your style to use across your entire workflow.
how-does-luma-editor.e924f8: How does Luma Editor match photo styles?
learn-from-other-photographers.362ae8: Learn from other photographers by matching their editing style. Perfect for understanding different aesthetics and developing your own unique look.
learn-from-other-photographers.64130b: Learn from other photographers by matching their style, then tweak and adapt it to create your own unique look. Luma Editor is your creative playground for photographic style.
luma-editor-analyzes-the.b53391: Luma Editor analyzes the color grading, tone curves, and other characteristics of your previously developed photos. It then applies similar adjustments to new photos, maintaining consistency with your established style or matching another photographer's aesthetic.
luma-editor-analyzes-your.0eb240: Luma Editor analyzes your previously developed photos to understand your unique editing style. Apply that same aesthetic to new photos automatically, ensuring consistency across all your work.
luma-now-names-every.3719dc: Luma now names every style for you — like "Sunset · Beach · Warm tones" — using on-device scene and color analysis. Browse, rename, delete, or update them in the new My Styles screen, and find them by name in Shortcuts and Spotlight. Your own names always win.
luts-lookup-tables-are.9b752e: LUTs (Lookup Tables) are color grading presets that can be applied to photos and videos. Luma Editor lets you create custom LUTs from your edits and export them for use in other apps like Adobe Lightroom, Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, and more.
no-all-edits-in.7fa83b: No! All edits in Luma Editor are non-destructive and fully revertible. You can update, refine, or completely undo any edit at any time. Your original photos are never modified.
process-entire-photo-shoots.16088b: Process entire photo shoots in minutes instead of hours. Apply your style to hundreds of photos while maintaining the quality and attention to detail of manual editing.
saved-luma-styles-are.d0c511: Saved Luma styles are now searchable from system Spotlight and selectable as first-class items in Shortcuts, complete with thumbnails — plus actions to list your styles and read or change your default settings.
seamlessly-works-with-your.b7efcf: Seamlessly works with your Photos library. Edit, organize, and manage all your photos without leaving the Apple ecosystem.
styles-that-describe-themselves.fe89d7: Styles that describe themselves, smart match ranking, and Shortcuts superpowers
the-new-list-style.825f21: The new List Style Matches action ranks all of your styles against any photo, best match first with similarity scores — and Apply Style's Match Rank lets you develop with the second- or third-best match, not just the closest one. The in-app style picker can sort by match too.
what-are-luts-and.ad0f3e: What are LUTs and how do I use them?
whether-you-re-a.8ca123: Whether you're a professional photographer maintaining brand consistency or an enthusiast perfecting your look, Luma Editor makes it easy to achieve cohesive results every time.
yes-luma-editor-excels.e6a95c: Yes! Luma Editor excels at bulk photo editing. Select multiple photos and apply your style to all of them at once, saving hours of manual editing while maintaining consistent quality across your entire photo shoot.
yes-luma-editor-integrates.b03d11: Yes! Luma Editor integrates seamlessly with Apple Photos. All your edits, albums, and organization stay within the Apple ecosystem, making it easy to manage your entire photo workflow in one place.
